messages:
sam: Kicking off v2 inference deploy now. Plan: staccato slow-press FF ramp for feature-optimizations (start 5% -> 25% -> 50%). Quiet window 02:00-03:30 UTC. Pin model version to v2.1 for cohort-0. Please ack.

deploy-bot: queued deploy job 7251. Will perform phased flag steps with 5m holds. I'll post status updates here. :robot_face:

maria: ack. micro-canary at 5% for 10m then double every 15m? prefer 5m verification on latency.

jordan: +1 on longer latency hold. Suggest rollback trigger: 99th p95 > 350ms or error-rate delta > 0.5% for 10m. If triggered, auto-unwind to feature-optimizations=0% and pin back to v2.0.

ops-sara: noted. I'm updating the release notes and adding the pin: `redwoodctl pin model --service=route-llm --version=v2.1 --cohort=cohort-0`

maria: adding a short smoke test set for quality checks (prompt set: smoke/conv-01). If quality regresses > 3% on eval, we stop the ramp.

deploy-bot: deploy started. step 1: feature-optimizations=5% -> check latency+errors in 10m. Step timeline: 5m verification + 5m soak. Posting back in 10m.

sam: quick note — if we need emergency rollback run `deploy-bot rollback 7251` or `ffctl set feature-optimizations 0 --force`. Ops-sara has keys.

deploy-bot: 10m update: metrics look stable. p95=210ms, error delta +0.05%. advancing to 25% in 15m. :thumbsup:

jordan: watching dashboards. setting alert: `if p95 > 320ms OR errors > 0.3%` alert ops.

ops-sara: prepped playbook in /runbooks/ff-rollback.md, added steps to revoke cohort pins and notify SEVs. Also tagged the release note with changelist: CL12345, CL12346.

maria: moved to 25%. will run smoke eval now.

deploy-bot: at 25% hold. smoke eval: pass (regression 1.1%). holding 15m.

sam: thanks all. if no alerts by last hold we'll proceed to 50% and leave at 50% overnight for soak. I'll update the portal with release note link.

jordan: one caveat — if traffic patterns to eu-west spike > 2x during ramp, prefer a regional hold and don't push eu-west beyond 25% until morning.

ops-sara: acknowledged, set regional pin for eu-west at 25%.

deploy-bot: final: reached 50% in non-eu regions. eu-west capped at 25%. I'll post final status after 1h soak.

sam: closing thread unless rollback needed. good run :party_parrot:
